svg.title: Rewrite for audience
svg.desc: Preserve the message’s purpose, then adjust address, directness, modality, vocabulary, detail, contractions and humour. A close peer may receive “Can you send the photo?”, while an unfamiliar organiser may receive “Could you please send the event photograph by Friday?” Keep purpose → identify relationship → adjust the full pattern → reread for respect and clarity.
